[EN] Whether one can or cannot risk his or her life is a simple question, but one that's very hard to answer. This really isn't for everyone. Do you want to try it nonetheless?
[ES] Si uno puede arriesgar su vida o no, es una pregunta sencilla, pero muy difícil de responder. Esto definitivamente no es para cualquiera. ¿Aun así quieres intentarlo?
